brief:
An Israeli air strike hit a residential building in Gaza City's al-Sabra neighbourhood, killing several people including children, Al Jazeera English reported. The strike destroyed the apartment where the victims were present.

The incident has prompted accounts of families grieving lost relatives in the densely populated area. Al-Sabra is among Gaza's residential neighborhoods that have faced repeated bombardment during the conflict.
dek: An Israeli air strike hit a building in Gaza City’s al-Sabra neighbourhood, killing several people, including children.
title: Israeli air strike kills children in Gaza City apartment
